ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (outer lobes) to low-intensity black pixels (central region and markings).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad central low-intensity (black) wedge extending from the notch to the peduncle. High-intensity (white) fields on lateral lobes are heavily interspersed with low-intensity linear and mottled pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 110 degrees and minimal vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with high amplitude jaggedness on the distal right lobe tip; moderate frequency peaks and valleys along the remaining trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep on the interior trailing edge transitioning to a convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark circular pixel cluster located in the mid-section of the right lobe; several smaller low-contrast circular spots near the central black wedge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional, high-contrast linear disruptions (rake marks) covering approximately 60% of the visible high-intensity surface area on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake mark scarring across both lobes; significant irregular tissue loss/jagged deformation on the far right trailing edge tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'target' like circular mark on the right lobe mid-field consisting of a dark outer ring and lighter center.
